The first Governor‑General of India was the head of the British administration in the Indian sub‑continent.  
He was the *Governor‑General of India*—the representative of the British monarch and the chief executive of the (later British‑controlled) Indian territories.  

- **First holder (Bengal, 1773‑1785):** **Warren Hastings** – appointed as Governor‑General of the Presidency of Fort William (Bengal).  
- **First holder of the full title “Governor‑General of India” (1833‑1835):** **Lord William Bentinck** – the second person to be officially styled “Governor‑General of India.”
